author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Raft Wars

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host presses PLAY. In the shop everyone buys with their own mouse and presses DONE.
tips: Turns rotate from Player 1 to the last player; each player aims with their own keys or mouse and plays their own shop.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: The brothers defend their treasure from the raft, taking turns at the bazooka. Online play runs in Ruffle Together: up to four players get a turn each, and the team shares the credits in the shop.
